'''January 2001 Phoenix tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ on 13 January 2001. [[DJ Andrews]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1620">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-viper-pops-in-phoenix-az-1-13-01d1620/ viper-pops-in-phoenix-az-1-13-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 14 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-viper-pops-in-phoenix-az-1-13-01d1620/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 January 2001
* '''Site:''' The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[DJ Andrews]]
